daily.name: UV Index
daily.text: Use sunscreen SPF30+ when outdoors around noon.
daily.text_zh: 中午外出建议涂抹 SPF30+ 防晒霜。

daily.name: Sport Index
daily.text: Great for jogging and cycling, stay hydrated.
daily.text_zh: 适合慢跑和骑行，注意补水。

daily.name: Clothing
daily.text: A light jacket is recommended for morning and evening.
daily.text_zh: 早晚稍凉，建议携带轻薄外套。
